The manuscript does not report any sensitivity analyses conducted by the review authors to assess the robustness of the synthesised results. It mentions that included studies did not perform cost sensitivity analysis, but no review-level sensitivity analysis is described.
There is no discussion of the robustness of the main analysis in light of sensitivity analyses, as no such analyses are reported in the text.

elements.quote: The quality of all included studies was assessed using the joint International Society for Pharmacoeconomics and Outcomes Research-Society for Medical Decision Making Modelling Good Research Practices Task Force (ISPOR) [19].
elements.reason: The manuscript reports assessment of study quality using ISPOR criteria but does not report overall certainty or confidence levels for outcomes.

elements.quote: The following criteria from ISPOR were used for quality assessment: conceptualising the model, dynamic transmission models, parameter estimation and uncertainty, and model transparency and validation (Additional file 4).
elements.reason: Reasons for rating certainty down or up are not explained; only study quality criteria are listed.

elements.quote: The studies included in this review exhibit various strengths and limitations, which will be outlined and examined below.
elements.reason: The Discussion section explicitly states that the strengths and limitations of the included studies (evidence) will be outlined and examined.

elements.quote: However, the review has certain limitations, which are outlined below: The review did not include abstracts from scientific conferences or other scientific meetings, potentially omitting important modelling studies conducted by national malaria control programs (NMCPs) to inform resource allocation decisions.
elements.reason: The manuscript includes a dedicated 'Limitations' section (text_17) that explicitly identifies limitations of the review process, such as the exclusion of conference abstracts and grey literature.

elements.quote: The absence of these studies from the review limits the comprehensiveness of the findings, suggesting a need for the development of additional approaches to better capture and reflect the full range of modelling activities being undertaken globally.
elements.reason: The text explicitly discusses the potential impact of the identified limitation (omission of conference abstracts), noting that it limits the comprehensiveness of findings and may not fully represent actual modeling use worldwide.

elements.quote: The findings highlighted the need for country-specific modelling analysis for malaria control optimization, country-specific epidemiological and cost data for analysis, performing cost sensitivity analyses and defining the perspective for the analysis, with an emphasis on subnational tailoring for data collection and analysis for more accurate and good quality results. Such efforts should include all efficient prevention and treatment interventions, and surveillance and vaccination to inform context-specific control and elimination efforts respectively.
elements.reason: Discusses implications for practice by highlighting the need for country-specific modelling, subnational tailoring, and inclusion of specific interventions.

elements.quote: Efforts towards developing publicly available applications of the models and sharing source codes to facilitate translation for policy engagement will enhance transparency, reproducibility and adaptability...
elements.reason: Explicitly mentions facilitating translation for policy engagement as an implication for policy.

elements.quote: It is critical that the future modelling efforts account for equity considerations and target at risk malaria populations that are hard-to-reach to maximize impact. Efforts towards developing publicly available applications of the models and sharing source codes to facilitate translation for policy engagement will enhance transparency, reproducibility and adaptability, and pave a way towards more harmonized models for malaria control optimization in the future.
elements.reason: Provides explicit recommendations for future research, including accounting for equity considerations and developing publicly available applications for harmonization.
